payload.title: The policy in force today is still the one approved in December 2021
payload.summary: Norwich's current Statement of Licensing Policy was approved by full council in December 2021 and took effect on 17 December 2021. It is what the council applies to licence applications right now, and it is the document linked from the council's own premises licence page. On its own terms it runs for no more than five years.
detail: The policy sets its own outer limit of five years, which is why the officer's report says a replacement has to be adopted by December 2026.
17 December 2021 is the day the policy took effect. The council does not publish the date of the meeting that approved it, so we cannot give that.
